sources.title: Jira pricing: Free, Standard, Premium, Enterprise

freePlan.limits: Free forever for up to 10 users

keyLimits.en: Per-user price shown is for annual billing
Adds advanced roadmaps and cross-team alignment features
Requires between 801 and 100,000 users; advanced analytics, scale and security

cautions.en: The per-user prices published on the pricing page ($7.91 and $14.54) are for annual billing; the monthly-billed rate is not shown on this page.

capabilities.en: Agile issue tracking with Scrum and Kanban boards
Customizable workflows for software development teams
Advanced roadmaps and cross-team alignment on the Premium plan

limitations.en: Free plan is capped at 10 users, forcing a move to a paid plan for larger teams
Enterprise pricing requires a minimum of 801 users, unsuitable for small teams needing enterprise features

reason.en: Alternative for product roadmapping and prioritization

missingAlternatives.name: Linear
missingAlternatives.reason: Main lightweight issue-tracking competitor aimed at software teams, not in the catalogue

missingAlternatives.name: Asana
missingAlternatives.reason: Common project-management alternative frequently compared to Jira, not in the catalogue

unknowns: Monthly-billed (non-annual) per-user price not shown on the pricing page
Tax treatment (taxIncluded) not stated on the pricing page
